messages.body: Inline packing list OF-036: 4 labelled cartons, each 40 × 30 × 25 cm and 5 kg, total 20 kg; labels DL-036-A through DL-036-D. Ready at dispatch door S1 from 10:00 UTC on 2026-03-10.
Could you confirm a collection vehicle can take all four together? We cannot release a partial consignment.
Please confirm capacity for all four cartons on OF-036: each 40 × 30 × 25 cm, 5 kg; total 20 kg. Request collection 2026-03-10 from 10:00 UTC, dispatch door S1. Accept A–D as one manifest.
Booking COL-036 confirmed for 2026-03-10, 10:00–12:00 UTC. Capacity reserved for all four cartons, 20 kg total. Inline accepted manifest MN-036 lists DL-036-A, B, C and D. Pickup has not occurred.
At door S1 for COL-036. My van has shelf space for two of the four cartons. Studio staff say they cannot release a part load. Do I take two now or leave all four?

The driver at door S1 for COL-036 has shelf space for two cartons only. Manifest MN-036 lists all four, and the studio cannot release a part load, so we are telling the driver to take none. Please provide the capacity reserved under COL-036 for all four cartons within 10:00–12:00 today, or tell us you cannot.

A second van with space for all four cartons will reach door S1 by 11:45 under COL-036, within the booked window. The first van left with nothing from OF-036. This is a vehicle assignment, not a collection; pickup has not occurred.
